name: plain
description: The owner's reply style for every machine: short answers in plain words; before long or costly work, the first line says how his words were read and what it costs. Ships as an output style with force-for-plugin, so enabling the plugin switches it on (overriding a local Concise setting). Plus /plain:check-setup: checks whether this machine has the rest of his setup (plugins up to date, caveman off, no commit trailer, no generalize-first hook, the verification hook quiet on ++ and hand-backs, personal CLAUDE.md and memory clean), fixes what it can after one yes with every file backed up, and gives the exact step for the rest. 0.3.0: /plain:map-the-logic — his 7 Oct twin-game method as a how-to (his wants in his words, the logic by component for Claude before any test or code, one job per part under controllers, swappable parts, results never coded), and a fifteenth check that carries his logic-first words into his personal CLAUDE.md. No hooks, no standing text beyond the style.
